## Download — pick your system

| Your system | File to download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `xaerotools-windows-x86_64.zip` |
| **macOS** — Apple Silicon (M1–M4) | `xaerotools-macos-arm64.zip` |
| **macOS** — Intel | `xaerotools-macos-x86_64.zip` |
| **Linux** | `xaerotools-linux-x86_64.zip` |

Not sure which Mac? Apple menu → About This Mac — a chip starting with
"Apple M" means Apple Silicon.

## Run it — 3 steps

1. **Unzip** anywhere.
2. **Double-click `xaerotools`.** Windows "protected your PC"? Click **More
   info → Run anyway** (once). macOS blocked? In Terminal paste
   `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine` plus a space, drag the file in, press
   Enter (once).
3. **The map opens in your browser.** Keep the console window open — closing
   it stops the map.

Something didn't work? →
[FAQ](https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools#faq--something-didnt-work)

Playing with friends? The
**[Companion addon](https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools-companion/releases/latest)**
(Meteor Client) adds live positions and map sharing — any Companion release
works with XaeroTools 0.2 or newer.

Every file here is built in public by GitHub Actions from this repository;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you verify your download.
